title: ANNEX — TRANSLATION SECTION
summary: The annex contains two extended song cycles. “You and I” follows the eighteen-parva arc of the Mahābhārata in compressed poetic episodes, while “The Unborn Mind” unfolds across twenty-eight cantos as a separate philosophical-lyric sequence. Both retain internal sequential navigation rather than being flattened into the book’s ordinary poem list.

entries.title: Canto 23
entries.summary: A meditation on body & consciousness, freedom & liberation and earth & natural imagery. It moves from ethics & justice toward body & consciousness, allowing the poem’s emphasis to change as it develops.
